question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page, enter your email, and follow the link we send to choose a new password.

question: I forgot my password.
answer: No problem. Use the "Forgot Password" link on the login page and we'll email you a secure link to set a new one.

question: I can't remember my login credentials.
answer: If you can't recall your password, use "Forgot Password" on the login page. If you've also forgotten your email, contact support and we'll help verify your identity.

question: How can I recover my account password?
answer: You can recover access by requesting a password reset from the login page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes for security.

question: How do I change my password while logged in?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Change Password, enter your current password, then set a new one.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Open Settings > Profile, edit your email, and confirm the change via the verification link we send to the new address.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This is permanent and removes your data after a 14-day grace period.

question: How do I create a new account?
answer: Click "Sign Up" on the home page, enter your email and a password, and verify your email to activate the account.

question: Why is my account locked?
answer: Accounts lock after several failed login attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or reset your password to unlock immediately.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and follow the steps to link an authenticator app.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and PayPal.

question: How do I update my billing information?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing to update your card or billing address. Changes apply to your next invoice.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase from Settings > Billing > Order History. Approved refunds take 5-10 business days.

question: Why was I charged twice?
answer: Duplicate charges are usually a temporary authorization hold that clears within a few days. If it persists, contact support with your order number.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Subscription and click Cancel. You'll keep access until the end of the current billing period.

question: Where can I find my invoice?
answer: All invoices are available under Settings > Billing > Order History, where you can download them as PDF.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Expedited options are shown at checkout.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, we email a tracking link. You can also find it under Orders > Track in your account.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to most countries. International delivery typically takes 7-14 business days and customs fees may apply.

question: My package hasn't arrived. What should I do?
answer: If your tracking hasn't updated in 5 business days, contact support with your order number and we'll investigate.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Start a return from Orders > Return within 30 days of delivery. We'll email a prepaid label once approved.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 30 days in original condition. Some items, like final-sale goods, are non-returnable.

question: How do I exchange a product?
answer: To exchange an item, start a return and place a new order for the replacement. This ensures the fastest turnaround.

question: The app keeps crashing. How do I fix it?
answer: Try updating to the latest version and restarting your device. If it continues, clear the app cache or reinstall.

question: How do I update the app?
answer: Update through the App Store or Google Play. Enable automatic updates to always run the latest version.

question: The website won't load. What can I do?
answer: Check your internet connection, clear your browser cache, and try a different browser. Our status page shows any outages.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach support via the Help > Contact Us form, by email at support@example.com, or live chat during business hours.

question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM local time, excluding public holidays.

question: Is my personal data secure?
answer: Yes. We encrypt data in transit and at rest, and never sell your personal information. See our Privacy Policy for details.

question: How do I change my notification settings?
answer: Go to Settings > Notifications to choose which emails and push alerts you receive.
